title: Corporate Advocate / Legal Counsel
description:
We are looking for a Corporate Advocate to provide legal guidance. Key Responsibilities:
- Draft, review, and negotiate various commercial contracts and agreements.
- Advise management on legal risks, compliance, and corporate governance.
- Represent the company in legal proceedings or oversee external counsel.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant industry regulations.
Requirements:
- Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent law degree.
- Active license to practice law in the relevant jurisdiction.
- Strong analytical and negotiation skills.
- Experience in corporate law or as in-house counsel.
